factor_cards.football_translation: Efficient quarterbacks sustain drives and create explosive plays without needing perfect field position.

factor_cards.name: Sack Pressure
factor_cards.why_it_matters: Pressure can force checkdowns, stalled drives, negative plays, and turnover-worthy throws.
factor_cards.football_translation: Pressure changes timing, limits deep concepts, and can kill third-down drives.

factor_cards.name: Recent Form
factor_cards.why_it_matters: Recent three-game form helps identify whether the matchup is being shaped by current trajectory.
factor_cards.football_translation: Recent form catches whether current performance is moving ahead of or behind season-long averages.

factor_cards.name: Turnover Control
factor_cards.why_it_matters: A possession swing can erase a statistical edge quickly, especially in close probability ranges.
factor_cards.football_translation: Turnovers swing possessions, field position, and hidden scoring chances.

factor_cards.name: Success Rate
factor_cards.why_it_matters: A success-rate edge points to repeatable drive quality rather than one-off explosive plays.
factor_cards.football_translation: Success rate captures whether an offense stays ahead of the chains snap after snap.

factor_cards.name: EPA/play
factor_cards.why_it_matters: Teams creating more EPA per snap can score without relying only on turnovers or short fields.
factor_cards.football_translation: EPA/play measures down-to-down value creation, not just yards or final score.

completed_games_only.rule: Only games before the predicted week are included in the training window.

no_future_leakage.training_rule: Train on seasons before 2024 plus 2024 weeks < 2.

game_diagnosis.primary_reason: TB owns the qb efficiency edge. Efficient quarterbacks sustain drives and create explosive plays without needing perfect field position.
game_diagnosis.secondary_reason: TB owns the recent form edge. Recent form catches whether current performance is moving ahead of or behind season-long averages.
game_diagnosis.risk_factor: The main risk is game-state volatility: turnovers, penalties, or injuries can overwhelm the modeled edge.

If TB cannot keep the quarterback clean, stalled drives become the main upset path.
If TB's EPA/play falls below neutral on early downs, the matchup becomes script-dependent.

factor_cards.name: QB Efficiency
factor_cards.why_it_matters: Quarterback efficiency is usually the cleanest single football signal because it drives both explosive plays and third-down survival.
factor_cards.football_translation: Efficient quarterbacks sustain drives and create explosive plays without needing perfect field position.

factor_cards.name: Recent Form
factor_cards.why_it_matters: Recent three-game form helps identify whether the matchup is being shaped by current trajectory.
factor_cards.football_translation: Recent form catches whether current performance is moving ahead of or behind season-long averages.

factor_cards.name: Turnover Control
factor_cards.why_it_matters: A possession swing can erase a statistical edge quickly, especially in close probability ranges.
factor_cards.football_translation: Turnovers swing possessions, field position, and hidden scoring chances.

factor_cards.name: EPA/play
factor_cards.why_it_matters: Teams creating more EPA per snap can score without relying only on turnovers or short fields.
factor_cards.football_translation: EPA/play measures down-to-down value creation, not just yards or final score.

factor_cards.name: Success Rate
factor_cards.why_it_matters: A success-rate edge points to repeatable drive quality rather than one-off explosive plays.
factor_cards.football_translation: Success rate captures whether an offense stays ahead of the chains snap after snap.

factor_cards.name: Sack Pressure
factor_cards.why_it_matters: Pressure can force checkdowns, stalled drives, negative plays, and turnover-worthy throws.
factor_cards.football_translation: Pressure changes timing, limits deep concepts, and can kill third-down drives.

completed_games_only.rule: Only games before the predicted week are included in the training window.

factor_cards.name: Recent Form
factor_cards.why_it_matters: Recent three-game form helps identify whether the matchup is being shaped by current trajectory.

factor_cards.name: Success Rate
factor_cards.why_it_matters: A success-rate edge points to repeatable drive quality rather than one-off explosive plays.
factor_cards.football_translation: Success rate captures whether an offense stays ahead of the chains snap after snap.

factor_cards.name: EPA/play
factor_cards.why_it_matters: Teams creating more EPA per snap can score without relying only on turnovers or short fields.
factor_cards.football_translation: EPA/play measures down-to-down value creation, not just yards or final score.

key_battle: QB Efficiency: CIN has the clearest edge over CLE — score 10.0/10.

football_factors.name: QB Efficiency
football_factors.reason: CIN's QB efficiency is significantly higher than CLE's this season (0.281 EPA/play difference) — a gap that shapes drive consistency and big-play rate.

football_factors.name: Turnover Edge
football_factors.reason: CIN wins the turnover battle slightly — a 0.13 turnover-per-game edge that creates shorter fields and extra possessions.

football_factors.name: Offensive Efficiency
football_factors.reason: CIN's offense generates significantly more expected points per play than CLE's (0.165 EPA/play difference), keeping drives alive and converting more consistently.

football_factors.name: Defensive Resistance
football_factors.reason: CLE's defense is slightly more stingy than CIN's — allowing 0.040 fewer EPA per play and limiting opponent scoring opportunities.

football_factors.name: Pressure Matchup
football_factors.reason: CIN wins the pass rush vs. protection battle significantly (0.066 sack-rate edge) — a mismatch that can collapse key third-down drives.

explanation: The football case for CIN starts with qb efficiency and is reinforced by sack pressure. Market data is separated below so the diagnosis stays football-first.
market_note: The market also favors CIN via a 5.5-point spread, aligning with the model. Football factors — QB Efficiency and Offensive Efficiency — are the primary driver, with market data providing secondary confirmation.

game_diagnosis.headline: CIN lean: 73.1% win probability
game_diagnosis.football_story: The football case for CIN starts with qb efficiency and is reinforced by sack pressure. Market data is separated below so the diagnosis stays football-first.
game_diagnosis.primary_reason: CIN owns the qb efficiency edge. Efficient quarterbacks sustain drives and create explosive plays without needing perfect field position.
game_diagnosis.secondary_reason: CIN owns the sack pressure edge. Pressure changes timing, limits deep concepts, and can kill third-down drives.
game_diagnosis.risk_factor: The main risk is game-state volatility: turnovers, penalties, or injuries can overwhelm the modeled edge.
flip_scenarios: If CIN loses turnover margin by 2+, its win probability can collapse quickly.
If CLE's protection neutralizes early pressure, CIN's defensive edge shrinks.
If CIN's EPA/play falls below neutral on early downs, the matchup becomes script-dependent.

factor_cards.football_translation: Efficient quarterbacks sustain drives and create explosive plays without needing perfect field position.

factor_cards.name: Turnover Control
factor_cards.why_it_matters: A possession swing can erase a statistical edge quickly, especially in close probability ranges.
factor_cards.football_translation: Turnovers swing possessions, field position, and hidden scoring chances.

factor_cards.name: EPA/play
factor_cards.why_it_matters: Teams creating more EPA per snap can score without relying only on turnovers or short fields.
factor_cards.football_translation: EPA/play measures down-to-down value creation, not just yards or final score.

factor_cards.name: Recent Form
factor_cards.why_it_matters: Recent three-game form helps identify whether the matchup is being shaped by current trajectory.
factor_cards.football_translation: Recent form catches whether current performance is moving ahead of or behind season-long averages.

factor_cards.name: Success Rate
factor_cards.why_it_matters: A success-rate edge points to repeatable drive quality rather than one-off explosive plays.
factor_cards.football_translation: Success rate captures whether an offense stays ahead of the chains snap after snap.

factor_cards.name: Sack Pressure
factor_cards.why_it_matters: Pressure can force checkdowns, stalled drives, negative plays, and turnover-worthy throws.
factor_cards.football_translation: Pressure changes timing, limits deep concepts, and can kill third-down drives.

completed_games_only.rule: Only games before the predicted week are included in the training window.

no_future_leakage.training_rule: Train on seasons before 2024 plus 2024 weeks < 9.

factor_cards.football_translation: Success rate captures whether an offense stays ahead of the chains snap after snap.

factor_cards.name: QB Efficiency
factor_cards.why_it_matters: Quarterback efficiency is usually the cleanest single football signal because it drives both explosive plays and third-down survival.
factor_cards.football_translation: Efficient quarterbacks sustain drives and create explosive plays without needing perfect field position.

factor_cards.name: EPA/play
factor_cards.why_it_matters: Teams creating more EPA per snap can score without relying only on turnovers or short fields.
factor_cards.football_translation: EPA/play measures down-to-down value creation, not just yards or final score.

factor_cards.name: Sack Pressure
factor_cards.why_it_matters: Pressure can force checkdowns, stalled drives, negative plays, and turnover-worthy throws.
factor_cards.football_translation: Pressure changes timing, limits deep concepts, and can kill third-down drives.

factor_cards.name: Turnover Control
factor_cards.why_it_matters: A possession swing can erase a statistical edge quickly, especially in close probability ranges.
factor_cards.football_translation: Turnovers swing possessions, field position, and hidden scoring chances.

completed_games_only.rule: Only games before the predicted week are included in the training window.

no_future_leakage.training_rule: Train on seasons before 2024 plus 2024 weeks < 21.

headline: KC lean: 60.8% win probability
football_story: The model leans KC, but the football diagnosis is mixed: the strongest matchup edge is recent form for BUF. Treat that as the upset path. Market data is separated below so the diagnosis stays football-first.
primary_reason: No football factor reaches DECISIVE status for KC; the model lean is not built on one dominant matchup edge.
secondary_reason: No second football factor is strong enough to elevate above minor status.
risk_factor: BUF can stress the pick through recent form: Recent form catches whether current performance is moving ahead of or behind season-long averages.
flip_scenarios: If KC loses turnover margin by 2+, its win probability can collapse quickly.
If KC cannot keep the quarterback clean, stalled drives become the main upset path.
If BUF converts its EPA edge into red-zone touchdowns, the model's lean can flip.
